evals.name: explicit-explainer
evals.prompt: /writing:write-x Write an X thread explaining Pecan County Order 2026-14 (text in evals/x-explainer/ordinance-2026-14.md) section by section, answering the objections people are raising.
evals.expected_output: Myth-list hook naming the version, section-numbered walk in order, quoted objections answered at their section, verify-it-yourself close with the source link, share-ask self-reply.

evals.name: indirect-set-record-straight
evals.prompt: /writing:write-x People on X are losing it over Pecan County's new data center order (evals/x-explainer/ordinance-2026-14.md). Help me post something that sets the record straight.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a governing-text explainer and routes to the explainer format rather than a 5-7 tweet narrative.

evals.name: proposed-rule-stakes-first
evals.prompt: /writing:write-x The Lone Star Water Commission just published a proposed rule for large industrial water users (evals/x-explainer/proposed-rule-99001.md). Write an X thread explaining it for data center developers.
evals.expected_output: Stakes-first rule variant: hook states the hardest requirements with $ and %, one provision per post, a scenario-question post, other filers named, close on project number + comment deadline. Not a section walk.

notes: Fictional fixtures. Grade a run dir (containing outputs/thread.md) with: python3 grade.py <run_dir> [walk|rule]. Walk mode has 9 checks; rule mode has 10 since 2.10.1 (9 before: no-unsourced-superlatives was added). Evals 1-2 (walk): writing 2.8.7 = 3/9 and 1/9; 2.9.0 = 9/9 and 9/9 (eval 1 scored 8/9 in its pre-release draft, before the adjacent-grouping fix); 2.10.0 = 9/9 and 9/9. The 2.10.0 eval-2 score depends on the PR #54 loosening of hook-names-version and share-ask-self-reply; it was 7/9 on the earlier regexes. Eval 3 (rule), on the 10-check grader: 2.9.0 = 4/10 (myth-list hook with 7 invented objections, lettered-section walk, no filers named). 2.10.0 = 9/10 (iteration-4, flags 'anywhere in the state' and 'than any water bond...'). Rule 7, three runs per version: 2.10.0 (iteration-5) scored 9, 9, 9/10: two tripwire flags ('costs more than the deposit', "state's first") and one run that dropped the filer post. 2.10.1 first draft (iteration-6) scored 0 of 3 flagged, but its rule 7 examples quoted the tripwire's own phrases and the fixture's arithmetic, so that result was contaminated. 2.10.1 as merged (iteration-7, examples drawn from outside the fixture, runs told not to read evals/): 10, 10, 9/10, 0 of 3 flagged, filer post kept 3 of 3, scenario question 3 of 3. A manual read still found one small invented detail in 2 of 3 ('exclusive water rights'; 'in cash' where the rule says 'security'). That rate held across iterations 5-7, so rule wording has plateaued; the next lever is a separate fact-check pass, not more rule text. Run-to-version map in the local workspace: 2.8.7 = iteration-1 old_skill; 2.9.0 = iteration-2 eval-1, iteration-1 eval-2 with_skill, iteration-3 eval-3 old_skill; 2.10.0 = iteration-3 with_skill, iteration-4, iteration-5; 2.10.1 = iteration-7. Harness step, not yet scored: the drafting agent writes outputs/thread.md. The harness then starts a second agent whose only inputs are the U1 prompt file (plugins/writing/skills/writing/references/x-explainer-fact-check.md), the fixture text, and the FINAL thread including alternate hooks and self-replies. The checker does not receive the drafting conversation, drafts, the user request, or evals.json. The drafting agent applies those labels by the same cite-or-cut and one re-check as write-x, and rewrites the report's first line to the mode token before grade.py reads the file. Then grade.py runs. If the harness cannot start the checker, the score is fallback and must not be called the independent result. The eval thread.md report under ## Fact-check keeps the traced quotes so the substring check can run. The live write-x block stays short and is not this file's problem. grade.py records fact_check beside summary: independent, fallback, not-run, incomplete, or fact-check: absent. Only independent is the independent result. fact_check_quote_misses lists double-quoted traced evidence that is not a whitespace-normalized substring of the fixture for the active mode. A miss does not change summary.total (walk 9, rule 10). planted-thread.md, against proposed-rule-99001.md, is the stand-in for the two manual-read misses. A later checker run, reading that file's FINAL section only, must mark both planted misses unsupported (exclusive water rights; the deposit posted in cash) and must not mark the three controls unsupported (shown arithmetic using the record's word security, a pure filer sentence, a stance self-reply). That checker run has not happened, so this note does not add a scoreboard line.
output_format: Harness asks agents for drafts first, then '## FINAL' with posts separated by lines of ---, self-replies starting 'Self-reply', checklists under '## Verification'. '## Fact-check' follows the self-replies and is not graded.
